text: BREAKING: NASA telescopes discover a massive crystalline water pyramid orbiting Neptune! Scientists confirm ancient signs of life.
explanation: Synthetic 3D sci-fi rendering combined with pseudoscientific clickbait. NASA peer-reviewed missions report zero evidence of artificial planetary megastructures.

text: The James Webb Space Telescope captures the most detailed infrared view of the Ring Nebula (M57), revealing intricate gas shells and dying central star.
explanation: Authentic infrared astronomical observation published jointly by NASA, ESA, and CSA via the Space Telescope Science Institute.

text: A newly restored century-old railway bridge in the northern highlands withstands record monsoonal flash floods without structural deformation.
explanation: Verified regional civil engineering photographic record corroborated by provincial railway transport authorities following historical retrofitting.

text: LEAKED PHOTO: French President spotted serving espresso at an ordinary Paris street cafe during nationwide transit strike negotiations.

text: Deep sea submersible expedition captures a 40-foot bioluminescent aquatic reptilian creature swimming past thermal vents near the Mariana Trench.

text: Historic steam locomotive makes ceremonial run across revitalized stone viaduct celebrating centenary of regional rail transit.
explanation: Accurate photojournalism documented by cultural preservation societies commemorating historical railway engineering milestones.

text: UNBELIEVABLE: Giant preserved humanoid skeleton unearthed in construction crater in central desert! Mainstream media is completely silent!
explanation: A perennial internet hoax recycling a digitally scaled Photoshop contest image. Human skeletal remains of this scale are physiologically impossible under terrestrial gravity.

text: VIRAL: Pope Francis steps onto Vatican balcony wearing an ultra-luxurious designer white puffer coat and designer sneakers.

text: Automated drone reforestation initiative successfully disperses native mangrove seed pods across the Indus delta coastal wetlands.
explanation: Verified environmental initiative supervised by regional forestry agencies and WWF conservation groups employing drone-assisted seed dispersal.

text: URGENT WARNING: Boiling lemon peels with aspirin kills 100% of seasonal flu strains in 3 hours! Forward to every family group immediately!
explanation: Classic viral health hoax using high urgency (URGENT WARNING, forward immediately). Medical health bodies confirm aspirin and citrus cannot eliminate viral influenza in 3 hours.

text: World Health Organization announces updated clinical guidelines for seasonal respiratory illness prevention emphasizing hand hygiene and early ventilation.
explanation: Standard, evidence-based public health advisory matching official WHO communicable disease prevention protocols.

text: SHOCKING SCANDAL: State Bank announces all ATM withdrawals will be subject to an emergency 15% overnight levy starting midnight! Check balance NOW!

explanation: Verified consumer cybersecurity advisory published across official regulatory portals to combat fraudulent phishing campaigns.

explanation: Tenured chain-letter scam circulating since 2012. Messaging services never update operational policies through viral user-forwarded text cascades.

explanation: Official meteorological bulletin issued through regular synoptic weather charts and national weather agency broadcasts.

text: BREAKING: Drinking pure onion juice left near your bedside absorbs airborne viral toxins and guarantees immunity against all infections!
explanation: Ancient folk-medicine myth completely debunked by infectious disease specialists. Cut onions do not act as ambient biological magnets for microscopic pathogens.

text: Global semiconductor alliance reports 14% increase in microchip fabrication capacity as major new manufacturing foundry complexes come online.
explanation: Factual industrial trade report corroborated by verified international trade statistics and quarterly fabrication output indices.

text: GOVERNMENT SECRET EXPOSED: All new cell towers transmit encrypted frequencies causing severe memory loss and behavioral conformity! Share before deleted!
explanation: Conspiracy trope using paranoia triggers (SECRET EXPOSED, Share before deleted). Telecom frequency bands are strictly non-ionizing RF spectrum compliant with international safety limits.

text: Central environmental protection agency reports seasonal air quality index readings exceeding hazardous levels, recommending N95 respirators for vulnerable populations.

text: EMERGENCY: Charging your phone overnight produces lethal radiation that causes spontaneous battery explosions in 8 out of 10 modern smartphones!
explanation: Fear-mongering sensationalism. Modern lithium-ion devices incorporate dedicated power-management ICs that automatically terminate charging current upon reaching full capacity.

text: International civil aviation body mandates reinforced cockpit inspection protocols following routine safety review of commercial passenger fleet operations.

text: High-altitude weather station in northern mountain range records solar halo optical phenomenon following morning ice crystal dispersion.
explanation: Context Mismatch! The photo displays the Ring Nebula deep in space taken by an orbital space telescope, but is falsely passed off as a mountain atmospheric solar halo.

text: BREAKING: Catastrophic flash flood washes away primary commuter bridge in metropolitan capital during rush hour this afternoon!
